name: Git Repository Read/Write Coordination
purpose: Coordinate deterministic, authorized Git repository reads and bounded writes for independently revalidated T20 repairs.
required_inputs: T18 execution authorization for all writes
T20 VERIFIED repair result for repair STAGE, COMMIT and PUSH operations
exact candidate patch carried by the T20 VERIFIED result
matching T20 patch fingerprint and T21 repair_fingerprint
matching T20 baseline and final tree fingerprints
allowed: verify branch, HEAD and repository snapshot
validate T20 VERIFIED patch data and fingerprints
validate baseline, final tree and exact changed paths
apply a verified patch after baseline validation
stage explicit authorized paths using literal pathspecs
push only an explicitly authorized branch
classify GitHub API failures and recommend bounded recovery
forbidden: repair write without T20 VERIFIED result
blind retries after permission denial or stale SHA
unverified retry after an ambiguous write

repair_handoff.fingerprint: SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 candidate_patch bytes; must match the result and the T21 request
repair_handoff.baseline: Live source tree must match baseline_fingerprint before the patch is applied
repair_handoff.final_tree: Live source tree after application must match final_tree_fingerprint before staging/commit
repair_handoff.paths: T20 patch paths, T20 changed_paths, T20 verification.changed_paths and T21 authorized changed_paths must match exactly
repair_handoff.rollback: On a pre-commit application or staging mismatch, T21 must reverse the patch and verify restoration; otherwise return FAIL_CLOSED
repair_handoff.authority: T18 authorizes; T20 verifies an isolated patch; T21 is responsible for the authorized Git transaction

403.rate_limit: Respect Retry-After or X-RateLimit-Reset and use bounded retries for safe reads; writes require remote readback before any retry.
403.permission_denied: Stop, inspect repository permission, scopes, branch protection and rulesets; do not blindly retry.

api_error_recovery.404: Verify owner, repository, ref, exact path and case, and authorized access. Do not silently switch branches.
api_error_recovery.409: Reread HEAD and the target path, reconcile stale state, and never force-overwrite.
api_error_recovery.422: Reread current state and validation details; rebuild from verified evidence.
api_error_recovery.429: Honor rate-limit reset information and use bounded retries for safe reads; writes require remote readback before any retry.
api_error_recovery.5xx: Safe reads may use bounded retries; ambiguous writes require remote readback first.
api_error_recovery.timeout_or_network_failure: Writes require readback before retry because the outcome may be ambiguous.
api_error_recovery.tls_failure: Fail closed; never disable certificate verification.
api_error_recovery.unknown_failure: Fail closed and inspect independently observed remote state.
api_error_recovery.confirmed_404_readback: A 404 starts as AMBIGUOUS_NOT_FOUND. Only the same verified identity, with successful 200 reads for exact repository, ref and exact parent tree, and the target absent from that parent's entries, may resolve it to CONFIRMED_NOT_FOUND. This is read-only evidence, not write authorization; never switch branches.

deep_audit.02_capability_completeness: Read, baseline verification, T20 patch revalidation, scoped staging, commit and optional push.
deep_audit.03_inputs: Repository state, T18 authorization, T20 VERIFIED repair result and bounded paths.
deep_audit.04_outputs: Git transaction result and immutable transaction fingerprint.
deep_audit.05_state_dependency: T03 state is read-only evidence only.
deep_audit.06_evidence_dependency: T18 authorization and T20 verified patch are required for repair writes.
deep_audit.08_downstream_consumers: Future PR, deployment, release and audit layers.
deep_audit.09_failure_modes: Dirty tree, branch drift, HEAD drift, baseline mismatch, scope mismatch, commit failure and push failure.
deep_audit.11_determinism: Repository fingerprints and transaction inputs are canonicalized.
deep_audit.12_concurrency: One active write transaction per repository; the lock is an execution artifact, not source-tree content.
deep_audit.13_recovery: Pre-commit patch failures are reversed and checked; committed history is never destructively rewritten.
deep_audit.14_gpt_limitation_coverage: Prevents stale context, wrong branch, wrong files and false Git success claims.
deep_audit.15_new_agent_usability: Machine-readable Git transaction request and receipt.
deep_audit.17_read_capability: Git status, HEAD, branch, diff, log, remote and refs.
deep_audit.18_write_capability: Only explicit scoped branch, stage, commit and authorized push.
deep_audit.19_testability: Temporary Git repositories provide deterministic isolated tests.
deep_audit.20_observability: Before/after repository identities and commit evidence.
deep_audit.21_integration_contract: T20 VERIFIED patch is revalidated and then consumed by an authorized T21 Git transaction.
deep_audit.22_missing_layers: PR, release and deployment remain downstream.
deep_audit.24_idempotency_replay_safety: Transaction fingerprints record transaction identity; persistent replay prevention is not claimed without a durable replay registry.
deep_audit.26_adversarial_red_team_coverage: Force push, path escape, pathspec expansion, lock replacement and unverified patch application are blocked.
